name: ReadEasy
description: A free readability checker built with React and TypeScript that analyzes text, calculates readability scores, and highlights the five hardest sentences to help writers improve their content.

paragraphs: A modern, free, and privacy-first web application designed for authors, bloggers, students, and writers to evaluate sentence friction, calculate Flesch Reading Ease scores, and identify their manuscript's hardest sentences with actionable suggestions.
features: Large Text Editor & Heatmap: Paste an entire book chapter, blog article, essay, or draft without character limits.
Real Flesch Reading Ease Formula (0–100): Mathematically calculated in real-time with zero hardcoded values or paid APIs.
Top 5 Hardest Sentences Identification: Ranks the 5 most challenging sentences based on word count, multisyllabic complexity, and syllable density.
Actionable Rewrite Suggestions: Provides concrete advice (splitting long clauses, replacing complex words with simpler alternatives, eliminating filler phrases).
Interactive Live Rewrite Scratchpad: Test revisions directly under each difficult sentence to immediately see word count and syllable reductions.
